h1Text: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Arunachal Pradesh

items.pText: FunPlay Systems supplies outdoor playground equipment to schools, towns and institutions across Arunachal Pradesh, from Itanagar and Naharlagun to district headquarters deep in the hills. Everything is made at our factory in Vasai East, Maharashtra. It travels to the state by road, and our installation team or a dealer sets it up on site, grouted or self-standing.

Arunachal is a long way from Vasai and much of the state is hill country, so a project here needs more planning before dispatch than a city job on the plains. We ask for clear photos of the site, details of the road a truck can use to reach it and a description of the ground. With that, we can suggest equipment that fits the plot, plan the parts that need to travel, and mark the safe play area on a layout drawing.

props.h3Text: Top factors which make us the most chosen Outdoor Playground Equipment manufacturer in Itanagar, Arunachal Pradesh

items.pText: We make the tough and heavy-duty playground equipment. Our products do not damage or break due to pressure, force, or environmental hazards. Apart from that, they do not rust due to summer, water, or snow. Additionally, our products do not have chemicals or gases that harm the skin of children. They are also safe for the environment and have safety certifications as well.

Being the diligent Outdoor Playground Equipment manufacturer in Itanagar, Arunachal Pradesh, our team makes outdoor playground equipment for kids. We manufacture a wide range of equipment for gardens and parks. Our products include Multi Play Fun System, Individual Items, Playground Surfacing, Garden Decor, Wellness Zone, and so on. In addition to that, our play systems have distinctive features and uncommon designs. We also use good and bright colors in the equipment for protecting equipment from UV rays, water, and dust. Moreover, we make theme-based products as per the needs and requirements of the client.

Our creative team makes us the reputable Outdoor Playground Equipment manufacturer in Itanagar, Arunachal Pradesh. We hire experienced and efficient persons to design outdoor play systems. They have proficiency in developing every kind of playground equipment. Apart from that, they introduce new designs for every product. In addition to that, our group of workers maintains the best quality of the products. They also follow strict quality practices during the manufacturing of every product.

richText.heading: Rain, slopes and cold in the hills

c: Arunachal gets heavy rain through a long monsoon, and hill roads can close for days after landslides. Where you can, schedule dispatch and installation for the drier months after the rains. Most hill sites need a levelled terrace with a retaining edge and a clear drainage channel, because water running off the slope will otherwise wash out the base. Grouting is usually the better method on such ground.
Higher towns such as Tawang get cold winters. Galvanised steel and roto-moulded plastic handle both the wet and the cold well, since plastic does not rust and the zinc coating protects the steel.

richText.heading: Who buys playground equipment in Arunachal

c: Government and residential schools are the main buyers in the state, followed by town parks and the campuses of defence and paramilitary forces. items.q: Can you deliver playground equipment to remote towns in Arunachal Pradesh?
items.a: We send equipment by road from our Vasai factory. For remote hill towns, tell us the route and any limits on truck size, and we will plan the dispatch and installation with you before production.

items.q: Which installation method suits a hill site?
items.a: Grouting into a levelled, well-drained base is usually the safer choice on sloping or loose ground. We decide the method after seeing photos of the site and the ground.

items.q: Do the materials hold up in heavy rain?
items.a: Yes. Roto-moulded plastic does not rust and galvanised steel is protected by its zinc coating. A raised base with good drainage keeps water away from the footings during the long monsoon.

items.q: What warranty applies in Arunachal Pradesh?
items.a: Three years on galvanised pipes, roto-moulded parts, composite laminates and play rope, and one year on springs, bearings and spare parts. It covers manufacturing defects when installed and maintained as per our instructions.
